units.english: Electromagnetic pulse weapons were originally developed by the Remnant during the early days of their colony, when they were living in fear that the Alphas would overrun human space and expand beyond it.

units.english: The newest revision of the EMP Torpedo Bay, the "Teciimach," contains two major improvements. The first is a mechanism on the launcher that alters each torpedoes' energy to ignore allies, letting Teciimachs be deployed without risk of ionizing yourself or the rest of your fleet.

units.english: The second is a significant reduction in the size of the launcher hardware, allowing space for a clip that is a third larger.

units.english: While originally developed as a heavy weapon to paralyze enemy capital ships, the Remnant have utilized on-the-spot assembly techniques to support their use on smaller ships. These pods sacrifice multiple assembly systems in order to fit them onto interceptor-class vessels.

units.english: To better fit the hit-and-run tactics used on interceptors and light warships, Teciimach Pods launch all ready torpedoes at once instead of in sequence, maximizing the ion damage dealt in a single moment.

units.english: The Ember Waste is an anomalous region subject to forces that defy conventional physics: Energy spontaneously pouring from the vacuum, material density far greater than one would expect to find in space - even around a nebula, a concentration of wormholes unheard of in the galaxy, and regions where the universe itself seems to be in flux. This region, more than any building or ship, is the Remnant laboratory where they study the deepest workings of the universe.

This region, more than any building or ship, is the Remnant laboratory where they study the deepest workings of the universe.

units.english: When asked to clarify whether the name refers to either ripping or crying, the technician looks at you with a curious expression, and replies 'both.' They then go on to explain that a very simplistic explanation for this weapon is that it is making micro-tears in the fabric of space-time, then cauterizing them together again. Should not the Ember Waste cry at the necessity of such weapons?

units.english: These massive weapons require special hardpoints, and are built in such few number that the Remnant distribute them directly on an as-needed basis. Due to the prodigious energy and fuel requirements, only the most massive of Remnant ships can support regular use of these weapons.

units.english: These crystals, mined on the Remnant planet Viminal, can store a surprising amount of power in a compact form. Crystals pure enough to be used in such a manner are hard to find, however.
units.italian: These crystals, mined on the Remnant planet Viminal, can store a surprising amount of power in a compact form. Crystals pure enough to be used in such a manner are hard to find, however.

units.english: The capacitors tend to leak small amounts of energy in the form of excess heat. This leaking of energy also results in a quicker dissipation of ionization, granting ships with these crystals some resistance against the occasional ion storms that occur in the Waste.
